# Wavefront Sources and Plotting Update

## Summary of Changes
- Modified `Wavefront` class in `src/helios/core/simulation.py`:
    - Added `sources` attribute to store origin information (object name or coordinates).
    - Updated `__init__` to accept `sources` list.
    - Updated `copy()` to preserve `sources`.
    - Updated `plot()` to use `sources` for labeling subplots.
    - Added `max_plots` parameter to `plot()` (default 5) to limit the number of displayed wavefronts when no stacking is used.
- Modified `WavefrontArray` class in `src/helios/core/simulation.py`:
    - Updated `plot()` to use `sources` for labeling.
- Modified `Context.get_input_wavefront` in `src/helios/core/context.py`:
    - Updated to populate `sources` list when generating wavefronts from Scene.
    - Uses object names for coherent sources (Stars/Planets).
    - Uses angular coordinates for extended source grid sampling.
- Added `tests/test_wavefront_sources.py` to verify the new functionality.

## Files Modified
- `src/helios/core/simulation.py`
- `src/helios/core/context.py`

## Tests
- Added `tests/test_wavefront_sources.py`:
    - Verifies `Wavefront` initialization with sources.
    - Verifies `Wavefront.plot` limits the number of plots.
    - Verifies `Context.get_input_wavefront` correctly populates sources from Scene objects.
